**AI should help people think better about (and with) other people.**
I design and study interactive AI for *thoughtful written communication* and for *teaching and learning*.

My [Thoughtful AI Tools Lab](https://thoughtful-ai.com/) has welcomed deep contributions from over a dozen undergraduate student researchers and developers. You can [try our writing tools](https://app.thoughtful-ai.com/) that support your writing without tainting your words. Watch the website for new tools and research results.

For more, see [Publications](/pubs.qmd) and [Projects](/projects.qmd).

## Teaching

I teach computer science, data science, and machine learning. Recent classes:

- CS 212 Data Structures and Algorithms (Fall 2026)
- CS 300 special topics
  - Fall 2025: [Human-Centered AI](https://calvin-data-science.github.io/cs300-hcai/)
  - Fall 2024: [Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)](https://cs.calvin.edu/courses/cs/300hci/24fa/)
- [DATA 202 Data Science 2](https://calvin-data-science.github.io/data202/), a data wrangling, predictive modeling, and visualization course in Python (pandas, plotly, sklearn, etc.), with a project emphasis. (In prior years I taught this using R tidyverse.)
- [CS 375 / 376 AI and Machine Learning](https://cs.calvin.edu/courses/cs/375/), formerly [CS 344 Artificial Intelligence](https://cs.calvin.edu/courses/cs/344/), a hands-on (but also concept-heavy) machine learning course based [F. Chollet's Deep Learning with Python](https://www.manning.com/books/deep-learning-with-python-second-edition) (formerly, based on the [fast.ai course](https://course.fast.ai/)) and Hugging Face Transformers
- [CS 108 Introduction to Computing](https://cs.calvin.edu/courses/cs/108/) and [CS 106](https://cs.calvin.edu/courses/cs/106/), Calvin's first-year Computer Science courses, in Python.
- INFO 602 Predictive Analytics (for Calvin's MBA program)

See CV for others.

## Doing research with me

I welcome students who are interested in human-computer interaction, machine learning, data science, interactive visualization, and Christian perspectives on data and computation. I have a range of ideas and ongoing projects, but bring your own interests too! Please contact me via email (Calvin: ka37) or Teams.
